name: Midou Narumi
source:
The manager of the "Mania Mate" anime shop. Narumi usually acts like a hot-blooded anime hero. He's very friendly to his shop regulars, like Seigi, and Narumi is popular thanks that. In his opinion, collecting rare anime related items is indispensable.
